caseNameFull: Kolender, Chief of Police of San Diego v. Lawson

opinions.text: C. A. 9th Cir. [Probable jurisdiction noted, 455 U. S. 999.] Treating appellee’s letter of October 19, 1982, as a motion for leave to present oral argument pro se, the motion is denied. Mark D. Rosenbaum, Esquire, of Los Angeles, Cal., a member of the Bar of this Court, is invited to argue this case as amicus curiae in support of the judgment below.
